Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyAli.description: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your [Spell|Spells] from your first valid [WeaponSets|Weapon Set]. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same [Spell] aligns your fate, [Empowered|Empowering] that [Spell]. Visages can only cast damaging, non-[Channelling], non-[Buff] [Spell|Spells] you could cast that have no cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyAnc.name: Ancestral Spirits
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyAnc.description: This skill is [Trigger|Triggered] each time you summon a [Totem|Totem], summoning an Ancestral Spirit [Minion] to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyBle.name: Bleeding Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyBle.description: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Physical] [Attack] damage in an area and [Aggravate|Aggravating Bleeding] on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyBlo.name: Blood Boil
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyBlo.description: Enemies in your [Presence] accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying [CorruptedBlood|Corrupted Blood] to enemies near them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyCor.name: Kelari's Malediction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyCor.description: Harness Kelari's power to passively [Consume] [Corpse|Corpses] in your [Presence], causing Corpse Beetle [Minion|Minions] to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until [Command|Commanded]. On your [Command], they rush the target and explode.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyDem.name: Demon Form
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyDem.description: [Shapeshift] into a demon, vastly boosting the power of your [Spell|Spells]. You gain Demonflame every second you remain in demon form, causing your Life to be lost at an ever-increasing rate. Maximum 10 Demonflame. Revert to human form if you reach 1 Life, use a Skill that isn't a [Spell], or reactivate this Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEle.name: Elemental Expression
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEle.description: Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your [Strength], for a bolt proportional to your [Dexterity], and for a wave proportional to your [Intelligence].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEle.name: Elemental Storm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEle.description: Create a stationary [Fire], [Cold] or [Lightning] storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] type for the [Hit] that [Trigger|Triggered] the storm. [Hit|Hits] which do not deal [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] will not [Trigger] the storm.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEnc.name: Encase in Jade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEnc.description: Consume all stacks of [Jade] to grant [Guard] based off your maximum Life for each [Jade] consumed. You cannot gain [Jade] stacks while you have [Guard].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyExp.name: Explosive Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyExp.description: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Fire] [Attack] damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby [Ignite|Ignited] Enemies. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyFir.name: Fire Spell on Hit
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyFir.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Hit] enemies with [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] and triggers socketed [Fire] spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyFul.name: Fulminating Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyFul.description: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Lightning] [Attack] damage in an area with high chance to [Shock]. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.name: Hollow Focus
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.description: While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your [Hit|Hits] immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] on enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun]. The bells are themselves always [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun], they can be [CullingStrike|Culled], and [Hit|Hits] against them are always [Critical|Critical Hits].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.name: Hollow Form
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.description: [Channelling|Channel] to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed [Melee] [Attack] once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform [Channelling|Channelled] Skills or [Conditional] Skills. Consuming a [Charges|Power Charge] creates additional images.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.name: Hollow Resonance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.description: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. [Critical|Critical Hits] with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyIne.name: Inevitable Agony
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyIne.description: [Debuff] all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from [Hit|Hits] to be tracked by the [Debuff]. When the [Debuff|debuff's] duration expires or can kill the target, the target [LifeLoss|loses life] equal to that tracked damage all at once.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyInf.name: Elemental Surge
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyInf.description: Grants your weapon [Surge|Surges]. Non-[Melee] [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] with that weapon Consume [Surge|Surges] to cause the [Projectile|Projectiles] fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyInt.name: Into the Breach
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyInt.description: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby [FlamesOfChayula|Flames of Chayula]. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyLif.name: Life Remnants
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyLif.description: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life [Remnant], and [Hit|Hitting] a target spawns a Life [Remnant] every few seconds. Picking up a Life [Remnant] grants you Life which can [Overflow|Overflow] maximum Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMan.name: Manifest Weapon
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMan.description: Manifest a copy of your main hand [Melee] [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon] as an immortal [Companion] to fight by your side. In addition to its standard [Strike|Strikes], the Manifested Weapon gains an additional [Attack] depending on its weapon type.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMed.name: Meditate
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMed.description: [Channelling|Channel] to [ESRecharge|Recharge Energy Shield] and allow that [ESRecharge|Recharge] to [Overflow|Overflow]. [Channelling] ends when you take damage or your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] is fully [Overflow|Overflowed].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMir.name: Mirage Deadeye
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMir.description: While active, firing a ranged [Projectile] [Attack] will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged [Attack|Attacks] for a short duration, then vanish.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMom.name: Moment of Vulnerability
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMom.description: Send out a temporal [Nova] to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. [Hit|Hitting] enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun], [PrimedElectrocution|Electrocution], or [PrimedFreeze|Freeze] causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of [Immobilised|Immobilisation] used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyPoi.name: Acidic Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyPoi.description: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Physical] [Attack] damage in an area. The thrown flask [Consume|Consumes] [Poison] on [Hit] to cause an acidic burst. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyQue.name: Queen's Procession
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyQue.description: While active, Sprinting turns you into a locust swarm which deals [Physical] [Attack] damage, which is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage, in an area around you. You take damage and gain [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup if this [Hit|Hits] any targets, but damage you take from other sources while sprinting will not apply [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] or interrupt your sprinting.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyRit.name: Ritual Sacrifice
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyRit.description: Sacrifice the [Corpse] of a [Rarity|Rare] Monster to grant you its [MonsterModifiers|Modifiers] for a duration, or gain a single random [MonsterModifiers|Modifier] at the cost of your own life force.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySha.name: Shattering Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySha.description: Consume charges from your Mana [Flask] to throw a flask that explodes, dealing [Cold] [Attack] damage in an area and inflicting [Exposure]. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed Attack].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySor.name: Sorcery Ward
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySor.description: Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] from [Hit|Hits] for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.name: Ruzhan, the Blazing Sword
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.description: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn [Minion], to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to [Strike] enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating [Fire] [Spell|Spells] when [Command|Commanded] to do so.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.name: Summon Infernal Hound
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.description: Activate to summon a [Reviving] Infernal Hound which [Ignite|Ignites] enemies near it.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.name: Kelari, the Tainted Sands
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.description: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn [Minion], to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you [Command] him to do so. Kelari delivers swift [Hit|Hits] with massive [Critical|Critical Hit] potential.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.name: Navira, the Last Mirage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.description: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn [Minion] to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you [Command] her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your [Allies] with her [Spell|Spells].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTem.name: Temper Weapon
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTem.description: [Channelling|Channel] to temper your main hand [Melee] [MartialWeapon|Martial Weapon]. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil [Empowered|Empowers] subsequent [Attack|Attacks] to Combust when [Hit|Hitting] enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTem.name: Temporal Rift
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTem.description: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the [Spell] to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] to the values they had at the time. Removes any upcoming damage delayed by Phased Form on use.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTim.name: Time Freeze
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTim.description: Release a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTim.name: Time Snap
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTim.description: Manipulate time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyUnb.name: Unbound Avatar
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyUnb.description: Gain [UnboundFury|Unbound Fury] by inflicting [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] with [Hit|Hits] on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyUnl.name: Unleash
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyUnl.description: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, [Empowered|Empowering] the next [Repeat|Repeatable] [Spell] you cast to [Repeat|Repeat] multiple times. Cannot [Empowered|Empower] Skills with a Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyViv.name: Vivid Stampede
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyViv.description: Call upon Spirits of the Stag, sending them leaping forward. Each Stag releases a damaging shockwave each time it lands, and any Stags that travel the maximum possible distance also leave behind [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyVoi.name: Void Illusion
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyVoi.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will cause damaging explosions. Copies created this way have 1 Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendanyMeta.name: Called Shots
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendanyMeta.description: Applies a socketed [Mark] Skill to a nearby unmarked Enemy every few seconds. [Consume|Consuming] socketed [Mark|Marks] will cause them to be reapplied to an unmarked Enemy. This reapplication can happen at most once every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAttrition.name: Attrition
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAttrition.description: While active, causes you to deal more [Hit] damage to [Rarity|Rare] and [Rarity|Unique] enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain [CullingStrike|Culling Strike] against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBarkskin.name: Barkskin
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBarkskin.description: While active, taking [Hit] damage from enemies to your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] causes you to gain [Armour] for a short duration. [Armour] gained from multiple [Hit|Hits] can stack. The total [Armour] gained from this Skill cannot exceed the [ItemArmour|Item Armour] on your [EquipArmour|Equipped Armour Items].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBearFuryOfThe.name: Fury of the Mountain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBearFuryOfThe.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and repeatedly pound the ground, creating [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBerserk.name: Berserk
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBerserk.description: While active, strengthens your [Rage], but causes you to lose Life while not losing [Rage].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlackPowderBl.name: Black Powder Blitz
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlackPowderBl.description: Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that [Blind|Blinds] and [Ignite|Ignites] enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any [Grenade|Grenades] in its area of effect to also explode.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlink.name: Blink
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlink.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown [Spell] that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlinkSandPlay.name: Blink
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlinkSandPlay.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown [Spell] that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBloodhoundsMa.name: Bloodhound's Mark
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBloodhoundsMa.description: [Mark] a target, making them suffer [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] build up from [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The [Mark] will [MarkActivate|Activate], [Consume|Consuming] itself to [Trigger] Blood Explosion, when they are [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned], or when they are killed if they suffered enough [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The [Mark]'s duration does not expire while the [Mark|Marked] target is suffering [BloodLoss|Blood Loss].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBoneBlast.name: Bone Blast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBoneBlast.description: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing [Bleeding].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBoneCage.name: Bone Cage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBoneCage.description: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and [Pinned|Pinning] those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBonestorm.name: Bonestorm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBonestorm.description: [Channelling|Channel] to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel [Impale|Impales] enemies [Hit], causing subsequent [Attack] [Hit|Hits] against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your [Charges|Power Charges] to cause much larger explosions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemChaoticInfusi.name: Chaotic Surge
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemChaoticInfusi.description: Grants your weapon [Surge|Surges]. Non-[Melee] [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] with that weapon Consume [Surge|Surges] to cause the [Projectile|Projectiles] fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemChargeInfusio.name: Charge Regulation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemChargeInfusio.description: While active, you gain powerful [Buff|Buffs] based on your active [Charges]. However, maintaining the [Buff] Consumes [Charges] every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemClusterGrenad.name: Cluster Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemClusterGrenad.description: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a ring of mini [Grenade|Grenades] that explode when they come to a stop.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemColdSnap.name: Snap
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemColdSnap.description: [Consume] the elemental energy from a [Frozen], [Shock|Shocked] or [Ignite|Ignited] enemy, creating an elemental blast that leaves behind an [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant]. The blast will spread to other enemies affected by the same [ElementalAilments|Ailment], but those blasts cannot spread further. Can also be cast on a Frostbolt to create a larger cold blast.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCombatFrenzy.name: Combat Frenzy
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCombatFrenzy.description: While active, grants you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] when you [Freeze], [Electrocute] or [Pinned|Pin] an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemConvalescence.name: Convalescence
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemConvalescence.description: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin [ESRecharge|Recharging] [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] and gain a [Buff] for a duration that prevents that [ESRecharge|Recharge] being interrupted. The [Buff] is removed at maximum [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] and the skill cannot be used while [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] is full.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCrossbowRequi.name: Requiem
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCrossbowRequi.description: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your [Crossbow] shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use [Ammunition].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCullTheWeak.name: Cull The Weak
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCullTheWeak.description: Dash to an enemy and run them through, [CullingStrike|Culling] enemies if their life is low enough. If this [Attack] kills at least one enemy, it grants you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge], with higher [Rarity] monsters granting additional [Charges]. Enemies around you that can be [CullingStrike|Culled] will be highlighted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDarkEffigy.name: Dark Effigy
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDarkEffigy.description: Raise a [Totem] that bombards enemies afflicted by [Chaos] damage over time [Debuff|Debuffs].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDefianceBanne.name: Defiance Banner
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDefianceBanne.description: While active, [Attack|Attacking] enemies builds [Glory]. When you have maximum [Glory], you can place an inspiring [Banner] for a duration with an [Aura] that grants you and nearby [Allies] [Armour], [Evasion] and movement speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDetonateMinio.name: Detonate Minion
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDetonateMinio.description: Detonate an allied [Minion] whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy [Attack] damage to nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDetonatingArr.name: Detonating Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDetonatingArr.description: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum stages, the arrow will create a [Detonator|Detonating] explosion at the end of its flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDreadBanner.name: Dread Banner
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDreadBanner.description: While active, [Attack|Attacking] enemies builds [Glory]. When you have maximum [Glory], you can place an inspiring [Banner] for a duration with an [Aura] that grants you and nearby [Allies] [AilmentThreshold|Elemental Ailment Threshold], [MaximumResistances|Maximum Elemental Resistances] and [Flask] charges.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElectrocuting.name: Electrocuting Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElectrocuting.description: Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on [Hit]. [Hit|Hitting] an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming [Lightning|Lightning] damage to build up [Electrocute|Electrocution]. This rod is removed when the enemy is next [Electrocute|Electrocuted].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalConf.name: Elemental Conflux
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalConf.description: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable [ElementalDamage|Elemental] power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen [ElementalDamage|Element]. The [ElementalDamage|Element] affected changes frequently, though the same [ElementalDamage|Element] can be affected multiple times in succession.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalInvo.name: Elemental Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalInvo.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Freeze], [Shock] or [Ignite] an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalSiph.name: Elemental Siphon
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalSiph.description: Dash to an enemy and nullify their [Resistances|Resistance]. Hitting an enemy with positive [Resistances|Elemental Resistance] will reduce their highest [Resistances|Elemental Resistance] to 0 for a duration and triggers Infuse Weapon, granting your [Spear] the maximum possible [Surge|Surges] corresponding to the removed [Resistances|Resistance]. If this skill doesn't remove any [Resistances], its cooldown is reset. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalSund.name: Elemental Sundering
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalSund.description: Plunge your [Spear] into the ground to emit a pulse that [Consume|Consumes] [Freeze], [Shock] and [Ignite] on a number of nearby enemies, [Allies] and [Corpse|Corpses]. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each [ElementalAilments|Ailment] [Consume|Consumed] causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalWeak.name: Elemental Weakness
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalWeak.description: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Resistances].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemEmergencyRelo.name: Emergency Reload
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemEmergencyRelo.description: Instantly reload all your [Crossbow] [Ammunition] clips and [Empowered|Empower] each clip's [Ammunition] to deal more damage for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemEntangle.name: Entangle
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemEntangle.description: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and [Slow|Slowing] them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplodingPois.name: Bursting Fen Toad
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplodingPois.description: This skill creates a toad that jumps around briefly, the toad then explodes, dealing [Attack] damage in an area and inflicting [Poison].  Damage you deal with this skill is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveGren.name: Explosive Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveGren.description: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveShot.name: Explosive Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveShot.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any [Grenade|Grenades] in its area of effect to also explode.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveSpea.name: Explosive Spear
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveSpea.description: Hurl a single payload [Spear] that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The [Spear] will explode at the end of its [DetonationTime|Detonation Time] or if [Detonator|Detonated]. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFangsOfFrost.name: Fangs of Frost
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFangsOfFrost.description: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a [ParriedDebuff|Parried] target [Consume|Consumes] the [Debuff] to cause an explosion of frost and leave [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFeastOfFlesh.name: Feast of Flesh
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFeastOfFlesh.description: [Consume] [Corpse|Corpses] near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per [Corpse] [Consume|Consumed].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFeralInvocati.name: Feral Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFeralInvocati.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to create visages which attack once with a socketed [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] [Attack], creating multiple visages if it has enough [Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFireball.name: Fireball
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFireball.description: Launch a large ball of [Fire|Fire] which explodes on impact. The explosion [Consume|Consumes] a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFlameLink.name: [DNT] Flame Link
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFlameLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFlashGrenade.name: Flash Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFlashGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that unleashes a [Blind|Blinding], [Stun|Stunning] explosion when its fuse expires.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemForgeHammer.name: Forge Hammer
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemForgeHammer.description: Hurl a fiery hammer that [Slam|Slams] into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a [Warcry] near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] in a spiral.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFortifyingCry.name: Fortifying Cry
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFortifyingCry.description: Perform a [Warcry] that grants [Guard] and [Trigger|Triggers] Shield Wave when subsequent Shield [Attack|Attacks] deal damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFragmentation.name: Fragmentation Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFragmentation.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with [Pierce|Piercing] bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a [Frozen] enemy [Consume] the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] cause it to explode. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFreezingMark.name: Freezing Mark
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFreezingMark.description: [Mark] a target, making them more susceptible to being [Frozen]. When the [Mark|Marked] target is [Frozen], the [Mark] [MarkActivate|Activates], granting you a [Buff] which gives extra [Cold] damage and [Consume|Consuming] the [Mark]. [Mark|Marking] another target while you have the [Buff] will remove the [Buff].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFreezingSalvo.name: Freezing Salvo
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFreezingSalvo.description: Passively gains [Seal|Seals] over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the [Seal|Seals], [Repeat|Repeating] for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it [Repeat|Repeats] normally, it will also [Repeat] an additional time targeting a different [IceFragment|Ice Fragment] in its area of effect if able, [DetonationTime|Detonating] those [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] immediately.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFrostDarts.name: Frost Darts
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFrostDarts.description: Conjures a number of icy [Projectile|Projectiles] that launch towards the target. [Projectile|Projectiles] that [Hit] a [Chill|Chilled] or [Frozen] target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to cause each [Projectile] to lodge into the enemy then explode.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFrozenLocus.name: Frozen Locus
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFrozenLocus.description: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the [IceCrystals|Crystal] is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFulmination.name: Fulmination
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFulmination.description: While active, the first time any Skill [Hit|Hits] a [Shock|Shocked] enemy in your [Presence], that Skill also [Hit|Hits] other [Shock|Shocked] enemies in your [Presence], up to a maximum.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGalvanicShard.name: Galvanic Shards
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGalvanicShard.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] beams when they [Hit] enemies. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGasArrow.name: Gas Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGasArrow.description: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a [Detonator] skill or if an [Ignite|Ignited] enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGasGrenade.name: Gas Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGasGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that causes a burst of [Poison|Poison] gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing [Poison|Poison] cloud. [Burning] effects or [Detonator|Detonator] skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGatheringStor.name: Gathering Storm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGatheringStor.description: Flip backward and [Channelling|Channel] to charge your [Quarterstaff] with [Lightning]. Releasing causes you to dash towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] performs a [Lightning]-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. [PerfectTiming|Perfectly Timed] dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground] in its wake. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGeminiSurge.name: Gemini Surge
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGeminiSurge.description: Grants your weapon [Surge|Surges]. Non-[Melee] [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] with that weapon Consume [Surge|Surges] to cause the [Projectile|Projectiles] fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGlacialBolt.name: Glacial Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGlacialBolt.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with icy bolts that create two walls of [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGrimFeast.name: Grim Feast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGrimFeast.description: While active, your [Reviving] [Minion|Minions] store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim [Remnant] on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to [Reviving|Revive] up to that much total Life of dead [Minion|Minions].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHailstormRoun.name: Hailstorm Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHailstormRoun.description: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to [Ammunition|Load] the accumulated bolts into your [Crossbow]. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHammerOfNgama.name: [DNT] Hammer of Ngamahu
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHammerOfNgama.description: [DNT] Build [Glory] by Break Armour and Igniting enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, [Slam|Slamming] into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHammerOfTheGo.name: Hammer of the Gods
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHammerOfTheGo.description: Build [Glory] by [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, [Slam|Slamming] into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHandOfChayula.name: Hand of Chayula
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHandOfChayula.description: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, triggering socketed [Mark|Marks] with increased effect and applying socketed [Curse|Curses] with increased duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeraldOfBlood.name: Herald of Blood
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeraldOfBlood.description: While active, killing an enemy with [BloodLoss|Blood Loss] will cause a bloody explosion that deals [Physical] [Attack] damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon], but is partially based on their accumulated [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The explosion destroys their [Corpse] if the enemy was [Rarity|Normal or Magic], and has a chance to [Aggravate] [Bleeding].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeraldOfPlagu.name: Herald of Plague
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeraldOfPlagu.description: While active, killing a [Poison|Poisoned] enemy spreads its [Poison] to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also [Hinder] them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHighVelocityR.name: High Velocity Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHighVelocityR.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with [Pierce|Piercing] bolts that apply [RivenArmour|Riven Armour] to enemies with [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour], causing any [Hit|Hits] against those enemies to deal extra damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHydra.name: Hydra Familiar
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHydra.description: While active, a companion Hydra will rear up from your body and regularly cast socketed [Projectile] [Spell|Spells] at nearby [Shock|Shocked], [Frozen], and [Ignite|Ignited] enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceShards.name: Ice Shards
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceShards.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceShot.name: Ice Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceShot.description: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceTippedArro.name: Ice-Tipped Arrows
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceTippedArro.description: Ready your active [Bow] or [Spear], [Empowered|Empowering] your next [Repeat|Repeatable] [Bow] or [Projectile] [Spear] [Attack|Attacks] to [Conversion|Convert] [Physical] Damage to [Cold] Damage and [Trigger] [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] on [Hit]. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a [Charges|Frenzy Charge]. Cannot [Empowered|Empower] [Sustained] Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIcestorm.name: Icestorm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIcestorm.description: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. [Chill] and [Freeze] on enemies in front of you are [Consume|Consumed] to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIncendiarySho.name: Incendiary Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIncendiarySho.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and [Ignite|Igniting] enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemInternecineDr.name: [DNT] Internecine Draw
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemInternecineDr.description: [DNT] Gain stack of cleansed and corrupted forms when attacking with a bow.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIronWard.name: Iron Ward
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIronWard.description: While active, stores a percentage of the [Physical] damage that is prevented by your [Armour] or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLightlessStal.name: [DNT] Lightless Stalker
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLightlessStal.description: Summons an immortal Lightless Stalker [Minion] which puts enemies it [Hit|Hits] under the Watcher's Gaze. Killing those enemies, or [Hit|Hitting] them if [Rarity|Rare] or [Rarity|Unique], causes this skill to summon temporary Foul Eye [Minion|Minions].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLightningRod.name: Lightning Rod
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLightningRod.description: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a [Lightning|Lightning] burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning|Lightning] beams can [Chain|Chain] to it. When [Chain|Chained] to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another [Lightning|Lightning] burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLivingBombPla.name: Living Bomb
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLivingBombPla.description: Plant a seed of [Fire] inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a [ElementalInfusion|Fire Infusion] [Remnant].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLunarAssault.name: Lunar Assault
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLunarAssault.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMagmaBarrier.name: Magma Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMagmaBarrier.description: While active, increases your [ChanceToBlock|Block Chance] passively and imbues your [Shield] with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next [Block|Block] with your [Shield] raised will expend the lava to [Trigger] the Magma Spray skill and grant you an [Charges|Endurance Charge].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMagneticSalvo.name: Magnetic Salvo
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMagneticSalvo.description: Aim skyward and fire energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other [Lightning] [Attack|Attacks] in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMalice.name: Malice
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMalice.description: While active, emits an [Aura] that continuously inflicts [CriticalWeakness|Critical Weakness] on enemies in your [Presence].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemManaDrain.name: Mana Drain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemManaDrain.description: [ManaLeech|Leech] Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly [Hinder|Hindering] them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemManaRemnants.name: Mana Remnants
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemManaRemnants.description: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] have a chance to spawn a Mana [Remnant], and [Critical|Critically Hitting] a target with [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] spawns a Mana [Remnant] every few seconds. Picking up a Mana [Remnant] grants you Mana which can [Overflow|Overflow] maximum Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMantraOfDestr.name: Mantra of Destruction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMantraOfDestr.description: Build [Combo|Combo] by successfully [Strike|Striking] Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum [Combo|Combo], use this skill to [Empowered|Empower] your next [Quarterstaff] [Attack], causing it to deal additional [Chaos] damage. Each kill with the [Empowered] [Attack] grants [PurpleFlamesOfChayula|Purple Flames of Chayula] for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMirageArcher.name: Mirage Archer
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMirageArcher.description: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged [Attack|Attacks] for a short duration, then vanish.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMoltenBlast.name: Molten Blast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMoltenBlast.description: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The [Projectile] explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMortarCannon.name: Mortar Cannon
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMortarCannon.description: Raise a cannon [Ballista] [Totem] which uses socketed [Grenade] Skills, with significantly improved [CooldownRecovery|Cooldown Recovery Rate].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOilBarrage.name: Oil Barrage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOilBarrage.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and spit [Oil] at enemies, creating [OilGround|Oil Ground] where the [Projectile|Projectiles] land. Consumes [Charges|Power Charges] if possible to instead [Channelling|Channel] a sustained barrage of electrified [Oil] that does not create [OilGround|Oil Ground]. [Projectile|Projectiles] are fired in sequence, allowing multiple [Projectile|Projectiles] to [Hit] the same target.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOilGrenade.name: Oil Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOilGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that bursts in a spray of [Oil] when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the [OilGround|ground] and nearby enemies in [Oil]. Oil created this way can be [Ignite|Ignited] by [Detonator] Skills or [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOverwhelmingP.name: Overwhelming Presence
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOverwhelmingP.description: While active, emits an [Aura] that makes enemies in your [Presence] easier to [Stun] and inflict [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] upon.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemParry.name: Parry
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemParry.description: Ready your [Buckler] to parry the next [Hit] you would take, [Block|Blocking] the [Hit] and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased [Attack] damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup. You cannot [Evasion|Evade] a [Hit] you could parry, but [Evasion] instead grants an equal chance to avoid this [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPerfectStrike.name: Perfect Strike
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPerfectStrike.description: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up your weapon with [Fire]. Releasing with [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] will create a damaging wave of intense [Fire].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPermafrostBol.name: Permafrost Bolts
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPermafrostBol.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at [Freeze|Freezing] enemies. These fragments can [Merging|Merge].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPhantasmalArr.name: Phantasmal Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPhantasmalArr.description: Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to [Ignite]. [Ignite|Igniting] any enemy with the Explosion also applies [Ignite] to enemies within range.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPinnacleOfPow.name: Pinnacle of Power
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPinnacleOfPow.description: Consume all [Charges|Power Charges] to master the elements, gaining [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] and the ability to apply [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum [Charges|Power Charges].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlasmaBlast.name: Plasma Blast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlasmaBlast.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, [Pierce] through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional [Projectile|Projectiles] are fired in a spread, unlike other [Crossbow|Crossbow] Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.name: Bow Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.description: Fire an arrow with your Bow.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.name: Crossbow Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.description: Fire a bolt from your crossbow.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.name: Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.description: Fire a bouncing [Grenade] that unleashes a shrapnel blast when its fuse expires.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.name: Spear Throw
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.description: Hurl your [Spear] with force. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if you have one to cause the [Spear] to explode at the end of its flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestAttac.name: Playtest Attack
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestAttac.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow using a melee weapon.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestSlam.name: Playtest Slam
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestSlam.description: Jump into the air, damaging enemies where you land.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestSpell.name: Playtest Spell
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestSpell.description: Launch a fiery [Projectile] towards a target.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPoisonBurstAr.name: Poisonburst Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPoisonBurstAr.description: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of [Poison|Poison] on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalAvatar.name: Primal Avatar
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalAvatar.description: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a [Rarity|Rare] [MonsterCategory|Beast] for a duration, [Hinder|Hindering] them. If you defeat the [MonsterCategory|Beast] while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the [MonsterCategory|Beast] as a [Reviving] [Companion].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalBounty.name: Primal Bounty
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalBounty.description: [Empowered|Empowers] the next [Projectile] Skill you use, causing it to create additional [Projectile|Projectiles] and fly faster.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalStrikes.name: Primal Strikes
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalStrikes.description: Perform a [Lightning]-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they [Hit] a [Shock|Shocked] enemy and refresh [Shock] duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Exposure], and can [Consume] [Shock] to conjure a stampede of spirits.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemProfaneRitual.name: Profane Ritual
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemProfaneRitual.description: Mark a [Corpse] with a profane rune, dealing [Chaos] damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the [Corpse] is consumed and you gain a [Charges|Power Charge].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRagingSpirits.name: Raging Spirits
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRagingSpirits.description: While active, [Fire|Fire] [Spell|Spells] you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly [Attack|Attack] them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these [Minion|Minions], and can pass through them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRake.name: Rake
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRake.description: Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting [Bleeding] on all enemies struck.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRapidShot.name: Rapid Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRapidShot.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a large clip of heated bolts. [Heat] builds up on your [Crossbow] as you fire them, and reaching maximum [Heat] will prevent you from firing or reloading these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume [Heat] for extra benefits. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRavenousSwarm.name: Ravenous Swarm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRavenousSwarm.description: While active and enemies are present, swarms of insects emerge from your body to pursue nearby enemies. The swarms are untargetable [Minion|Minions] that [Attack] and [Poison] enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemReapersInvoca.name: Reaper's Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemReapersInvoca.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you kill an enemy with a [Melee] [Attack]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRedQueenVisag.name: [DNT] Red Queen's Visage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRedQueenVisag.description: [DNT] A host of crimson souls erupt from Atziri's Mirror when you Parry, which travel outward to enemies in front of you applying the Parried Debuff and Scar of the Red Queen.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemResonatingShi.name: Resonating Shield
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemResonatingShi.description: Repeatedly hammer your [Shield|Shield] with your weapon causing damaging shockwaves in an area around you. Enemies hit by the shockwave lose [Armour|Armour] for a duration. While [Channelling] Resonating Shield, your [Shield|Shield] is raised and you will [Block|Block] all incoming [Block|Blockable] hits.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSacrifice.description: While active, your undead [Reviving] [Minion|Minions] can be used in place of [Corpse|Corpses] by your skills, but your [Minion|Minions] [Reviving|Revive] more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSanguineRevel.name: Sanguine Revelry
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSanguineRevel.description: Conjure hateful energy to fuel your Rage and Life. While active, [Bleeding] enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Hateful [Remnant], and [Hit|Hitting] a [Bleeding] target spawns a Hateful [Remnant] every few seconds. Picking up a Hateful [Remnant] grants you Rage and recovers Life based on your current Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemScavengedPlat.name: Scavenged Plating
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemScavengedPlat.description: While active, uses fragments of armour scavenged from enemies to bolster your own. [ArmourBreak|Fully Breaking] an enemy's [Armour] grants you stacks of Scavenged Plating for a duration based on the enemy's [Rarity], and you gain [Armour] and [Thorns] per stack. Normal enemies grant 1 stack, Magic enemies grant 2 stacks, Rare enemies grant 5 stacks and Unique enemies grant 10 stacks.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShardScavenge.name: Shard Scavenger
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShardScavenge.description: While active, [Consume|Consuming] [Freeze], [Shock], [Ignite], or [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour] on an enemy reloads your [Crossbow|Crossbow], restores one cooldown use for your [Grenade|Grenades] and grants a [Buff] causing [Crossbow|Crossbow] [Attack|Attacks] to not consume bolts for a duration. This can only occur once every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShieldBlock.name: Raise Shield
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShieldBlock.description: Raise your [Shield] to [Block] all incoming [Block|Blockable] hits. Release immediately after [Block|Blocking] when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and [Stun|Stunning] enemies. While your [Shield] is raised you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned] by hits you [Block], but [Block|Blocking] too much damage may [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] you. You cannot [Evasion|Evade] while your [Shield] is raised, but [Evasion] instead grants an equal chance to avoid this [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShieldWall.name: Shield Wall
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShieldWall.description: Ram your [Shield] into the ground, throwing up a wall of earth. Enemies can attack your wall segments, and your [Slam|Slams], [Warcry|Warcries], and Shield Charge will instantly shatter them all. The segments explode when shattered, damaging enemies in front of and around them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShockburstRou.name: Shockburst Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShockburstRou.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with a clip of charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon [Hit|Hitting] an enemy affected by a [LightningAilment|Lightning Ailment]. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShockchainArr.name: Shockchain Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShockchainArr.description: Fire a [Lightning]-charged arrow that homes in on enemies afflicted by [LightningAilment|Lightning Ailments]. Hitting such an enemy will cause your arrow to release a damaging shockwave and [Chain] towards nearby targets, with those [Chain|Chaining] [Hit|Hits] also releasing a shockwave. After the final [Chain], the arrow lodges into the ground as a Lightning Rod. [Consume|Consumes] [Shock] from enemies it [Hit|Hits], but not [Electrocute|Electrocution].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiegeCascade.name: Siege Cascade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiegeCascade.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiphonElement.name: Siphon Elements
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiphonElement.description: While active, has a chance to create an [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] [Remnant] when you [Freeze], [Shock] or [Ignite] a target.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiphoningStri.name: Siphoning Strike
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiphoningStri.description: Dash to a target and [Strike|Strike] them with your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff]. If the target is [Shock|Shocked], [Consume] their [Shock|Shock] to release a [Lightning|Lightning] shockwave around the target and grant you a [Charges|Power Charge]. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSnipe.name: Snipe
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSnipe.description: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing with [PerfectTiming|Perfect Timing] causes the arrow to explode on impact and [Consume] [Freeze] on directly [Hit|Hitting]. [Consume|Consuming] [Freeze] enhances the explosion.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSolarOrb.name: Solar Orb
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSolarOrb.description: Create a fiery [Orb|Orb] that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the [Orb|Orb] are [Ignite|Ignited]. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSoulLink.name: [DNT] Soul Link
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSoulLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSoulOffering.name: Soul Offering
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSoulOffering.description:
Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike, granting you a powerful [Spell] damage [Buff] as long as the spike remains. Does not affect your [Minion|Minions]. 
The bone spike is itself a [Minion]. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpearOfSolari.name: Spear of Solaris
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpearOfSolari.description: Build [Glory] by inflicting [Freeze], [Shock] or [Ignite] on enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may call forth the Azmeri goddess Solaris, jumping backwards and throwing your [Spear] in the air. On landing the spear deals heavy damage in an area, then calls a divine skybeam that pulses periodically and creates expanding [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground]. Modifiers to number of [Projectile|Projectiles] fired do not apply to this skill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpearWindVort.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Spear Vortex
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpearWindVort.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Performs a sweeping [Spear] [Attack] which draws Enemies in range closer to you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpellslinger.name: Spellslinger
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpellslinger.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you cast [Spell|Spells]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStampede.name: Stampede
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStampede.description: Charges forward, cracking the earth and leaving a patch of [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] with every footstep. At the end of your charge, a massive leaping [Slam] damages enemies and causes all nearby patches of [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] to explode, damaging enemies standing on them. Once you begin your charge, the use speed of this Skill is affected by movement speed instead of [Attack] speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormLance.name: Storm Lance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormLance.description: Throw an electrified [Spear] that lodges in the ground and periodically zaps nearby enemies with [Lightning] bolts. If the [Spear] is [Detonator|Detonated] by another Skill, it immediately unleashes a volley of bolts and expires. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to fire bolts more frequently for a shorter duration, automatically Detonate at the end of its duration, and create [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground] on Detonation.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormWave.name: Storm Wave
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormWave.description: Sweep your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff], projecting a bolt of [Lightning] through the ground in a long fissure ahead of you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormblastBol.name: Stormblast Bolts
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormblastBol.description: [Ammunition|Load your Crossbow] with charged bolts that land around the target location and explode if hit by a [Detonator] Skill. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormcallerAr.name: Stormcaller Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormcallerAr.description: Fire an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a [Lightning] Bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies, with a high chance to [Shock]. [Shock|Shocking] any enemy with the Bolt also applies [Shock] to all enemies near the impact.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTameBeast.name: Tame Beast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTameBeast.description: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a [Rarity|Rare] [MonsterCategory|Beast] for a duration, [Hinder|Hindering] them. If you defeat the [MonsterCategory|Beast] while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the [MonsterCategory|Beast] as a [Reviving] [Companion].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTempestBell.name: Tempest Bell
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTempestBell.description: Build [Combo|Combo] by successfully [Strike|Striking] Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum [Combo|Combo], use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be [Hit] by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and [Hit|Hits] which would have caused [Knockback] increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemThrashingVine.name: Thrashing Vines
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemThrashingVine.description: Spur the growth of huge vines, which emerge randomly within the target area. The vines crash to the ground then retreat, targeting nearby enemies if possible.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemThunderousLea.name: Thunderous Leap
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemThunderousLea.description: Leap into the air and plunge your [Spear] into the ground at the target location, emitting a [Lightning]-charged shockwave.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTimeOfNeed.name: Time of Need
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTimeOfNeed.description: While active, periodically invokes divine blessings to heal you and remove [Curse|Curses] and [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] from you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTornadoShot.name: Tornado Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTornadoShot.description: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing [Physical] damage over time and [Hinder|Hindering] enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown [Spear|Spears] and [Crossbow] bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied [Projectile|Projectiles]. Copied [Projectile|Projectiles] cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemToxicDomain.name: Toxic Domain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemToxicDomain.description: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks] attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be [Poison|Poisoned]. Pustules will [DetonationTime|Detonate] after a duration or when enough [Poison] has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored [Poison] damage and applying [Poison] in an area around it.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemToxicGrowth.name: Toxic Growth
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemToxicGrowth.description: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then [DetonationTime|Detonate] after a delay. They can also be [Poison|Poisoned], causing them to [DetonationTime|Detonate] faster and more violently.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTriggeredAbys.name: Abyssal Apparition
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTriggeredAbys.description: Consume a [Charges|Power Charge] when you cast a damaging [Spell] to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same [Spell] for you. Does not work with [Channelling] Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, [Trigger|Triggered] Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a [Charges|Power Charge]. This Skill is not directly Supportable.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTriggeredGasC.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Gas Cloud
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTriggeredGasC.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Creates a [Poison|Poison] cloud. [Burning] effects or [Detonator|Detonator] skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast. (Wording copied from Toxic Grenade.)

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTrinity.name: Trinity
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTrinity.description: Become attuned to all [ElementalDamage|Elements] building up Fire, Cold and Lightning [Affinity] based off the highest [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] type dealt by your [Hit|Hits]. Your [ElementalDamage|Elemental Damage] is enhanced the more [Affinity] of any type you have.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTwister.name: Twister
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTwister.description: Whip up a twister with a flick of your [Spear]. The twister moves forward erratically, [Blind|Blinding] and repeatedly [Hit|Hitting] enemies within. If a twister touches a [Whirlwind] from your other skills, it Consumes the [Whirlwind] to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Passing over [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surfaces] or Consuming an elemental [Whirlwind] will grant twisters extra damage of that element.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUnearth.name: Unearth
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUnearth.description: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of [Corpse|Corpses] and dead [Reviving] [Minion|Minions] in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct [Minion|Minions] that fight for you. Larger [Corpse|Corpses] create more than one Bone Construct.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueBreachL.name: Lightning Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueBreachL.description: Call down a [Shock|Shocking] bolt of [Lightning] to strike enemies in a small area.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueDuskVig.name: Ember Fusillade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueDuskVig.description: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing [Fire] damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. [Consume|Consumes] a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that [Chain] to enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueEarthbo.name: Spark
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueEarthbo.description: Launch a spray of sparking [Projectile|Projectiles] that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVaultingImpac.name: Vaulting Impact
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVaultingImpac.description: Leap forward and [Slam] the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies [BrokenStance|Broken Stance] to [Daze|Dazed] enemies, causing any [Hit|Hits] against those enemies to deal extra damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVineArrow.name: Vine Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVineArrow.description: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, [Slow|Slowing] their movement speed and dealing [Chaos] damage over time. The plant can be [Poison|Poisoned], causing it to deal more damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVoltaicMark.name: Voltaic Mark
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVoltaicMark.description: [Mark] a target, making them more susceptible to being [Electrocute|Electrocuted]. When the [Mark|Marked] target is [Electrocute|Electrocuted], the [Mark] [MarkActivate|Activates], granting a [Buff] which gives extra [Lightning] damage and [Consume|Consuming] the [Mark]. [Mark|Marking] another target while you have the [Buff] will remove the [Buff].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWarBanner.name: War Banner
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWarBanner.description: While active, [Attack|Attacking] enemies builds [Glory]. When you have maximum [Glory], you can place an inspiring [Banner] for a duration with an [Aura] that grants you and nearby [Allies] [Attack] damage, [Attack] speed and [Accuracy].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWhirlwindLanc.name: Whirlwind Lance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWhirlwindLanc.description: Throw a [Spear] with enough force to kick up a [Whirlwind] where it lands, [Slow|Slowing] enemies and [Blind|Blinding] them in its area of effect. Entering the [Whirlwind] collapses it, dealing damage and causing [Knockback]. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to create the [Whirlwind] with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWildProtector.name: Wild Protector
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWildProtector.description: Call upon a Bear Spirit [Companion] to maul your foes. The Bear Spirit leaps at enemies to [Maim] them, [Leech|Leeches] Life with its slam, and periodically roars to [Intimidate] enemies. The Bear Spirit does not count toward your [Companion] limit.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWindDancer.name: Wind Dancer
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWindDancer.description: While active, periodically grants stages of a buff that gives you more [Evasion] per stage. Being [Hit] by an Enemy while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and [Knockback|Knock Back] enemies around you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWindSerpentsF.name: Wind Serpent's Fury
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWindSerpentsF.description: Consume all [Charges|Frenzy Charges] to perform a gigantic spear thrust that [Knockback|Knocks Back] enemies. For each [Charges|Frenzy Charge] consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and [Knockback|Knocks Back] enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWingBlast.name: Wing Blast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWingBlast.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and launch yourself backwards with a powerful wingbeat that [Knockback|Knocks Back] enemies. Enemies [PrimedStun|Primed] for [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] will be stunned, release a shockwave, and have a chance to grant you a [Charges|Power Charge]. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWitheringPres.name: Withering Presence
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWitheringPres.description: While active, emits an [Aura] that periodically [Withered|Withers] enemies in your [Presence].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfArcticHow.name: Arctic Howl
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfArcticHow.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and [Freeze|Freezes] [PrimedFreeze|Primed] enemies. If an enemy is [Frozen] or a [Frozen] enemy is [Hit], this Skill [Empowered|Empowers] your attacks with added [Cold] damage, causes [Empowered] [Slam|Slams] to create [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground], and grants your [Allies] added [Cold] damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfCrossSlas.name: Cross Slash
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfCrossSlas.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and leap backwards as you gouge the ground with both claws. Enemies can be [Hit] separately by both gouges. [Hit|Hitting] a [Mark|Marked] enemy with both gouges will [MarkActivate|Activate] the [Mark] and cause an additional shockwave. [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] will be pulled into the location where the gouges cross and explode. immediately. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfLunarBles.name: Lunar Blessing
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfLunarBles.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and offer your [Rage] to the moon to receive a blessing, gaining bonus [Cold] damage for yourself and any Wolf [Minion|Minions] you have from Wolf Pack or Predator's Mark. Spends all [Rage] to extend the [Buff]'s duration. While the [Buff] is active, your [Werewolf] [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] call down Moonbeams on [Hit].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfShred.name: Shred
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfShred.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Werewolf] and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first [Attack] can dash to faraway enemies and the final [Attack] [Strike|Strikes] twice. [Attack|Attacking] a [Frozen] enemy will create [IceFragment|Ice Fragments], which are [Projectile|Projectiles] that land and explode after a short delay.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWyvernDevour.name: Devour
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWyvernDevour.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and devour a [Corpse] or [CullingStrike|Cullable] enemy, and additional nearby [Corpse|Corpses]. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a [Charges|Power Charge]. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a [Slam].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWyvernFlameBr.name: Flame Breath
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWyvernFlameBr.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and take to the skies, immolating enemies with a jet of fire. [Channelling] ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending [Rage]. Consumes a [Charges|Power Charge] if possible to [Empowered|Empower] the Skill, [Gain|Gaining] extra [Lightning] damage and spending [Rage] more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAbidingHex.name: Abiding Hex
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAbidingHex.description: Supports [Curse] Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume [Charges|Power Charges] on use, gaining significant [Curse] duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume [Charges|Power Charges].
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAbidingHex.supportText: Supports [Curse] Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume [Charges|Power Charges] on use, gaining significant [Curse] duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume [Charges|Power Charges].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAblation.name: Sacrificial Offering
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAblation.description: Supports [Offering] Skills. Supported Skills [Sacrifice] a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful [Buff|Buffs] in return.
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAblation.supportText: Supports [Offering] Skills. Supported Skills [Sacrifice] a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful [Buff|Buffs] in return.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAcrimony.name: Acrimony
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAcrimony.description: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a [DamagingAilments|Damaging Ailment] have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this [Debuff] will apply. Does not Support Skills used by [Minion|Minions].

Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a [DamagingAilments|Damaging Ailment] have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this [Debuff] will apply. Does not Support Skills used by [Minion|Minions].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhere.name: Adhesive Grenades I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhere.description: Supports [Grenade] Skills. [Grenade|Grenades] from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhere.supportText: Supports [Grenade] Skills. [Grenade|Grenades] from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhereThree.name: Adhesive Grenades III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhereThree.description: Supports [Grenade] Skills. [Grenade|Grenades] from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land. [Grenade|Grenades] from Supported Skills have longer cooldowns, and a chance to detonate an additional time.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhereTwo.name: Adhesive Grenades II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhereTwo.description: Supports [Grenade] Skills. [Grenade|Grenades] from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWarmBlooded.supportText: Supports [Persistent] [Buff] Skills, causing [Freeze] applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWildshards.description: Supports [Projectile] [Spell|Spells]. Supported [Spell|Spells] have a chance to fire many additional [Projectile|Projectiles] in a circle.
