Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXibaquasRen.name: Xibaqua's Rending
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXibaquasRen.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing [Corpse|Corpses] in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXibaquasRen.supportText: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing [Corpse|Corpses] in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXophsPyre.name: Xoph's Pyre
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXophsPyre.description: Supports Skills that can cause [Hit|Damaging Hits], granting extra [Chaos] damage and causing [Chaos] damage to [Contributes|Contribute] to [Ignite|Ignites].
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXophsPyre.supportText: Supports Skills that can cause [Hit|Damaging Hits], granting extra [Chaos] damage and causing [Chaos] damage to [Contributes|Contribute] to [Ignite|Ignites].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZarokhsRefr.name: Zarokh's Refrain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZarokhsRefr.description: Supports [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell|Spells] you cast yourself. Supported [Spell|Spells] [Cascadable|Echo] thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZenith.name: Zenith I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZenith.description: Supports [Spell] Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZenith.supportText: Supports [Spell] Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZenithTwo.name: Zenith II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZenithTwo.description: Supports [Spell] Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost [Efficiency] and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by [Minion|Minions].

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZerphisLega.description:
Supports [Attack|Attacks] and [Warcry|Warcries] you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a [Glory] requirement, and build [Glory] when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAbyssalPact.name: Abyssal Pact
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAbyssalPact.description: Sacrifice some of a damageable [Minion|Minion's] life to deal [Physical] damage in an area around it.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.name: Ancestral Warrior Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.description: Consume 3 [Charges|Endurance Charges] to Raise a [Totem|Totem] that conjures spirit warriors. Each warrior uses a socketed [Mace] Skill once, then disappears. Cannot use [Channelling] Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncientGifts.name: Wildwood's Gifts
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncientGifts.description: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby [AncientBlooms|Ancient Blooms].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusExchan.name: Animus Exchange
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusExchan.description: [Sacrifice] a portion of your Life to recover [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Ward|Runic Ward] recovered by this Skill can [Overflow].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusSplint.name: Animus Splinters
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusSplint.description: Expend a large amount of [Ward|Runic Ward] to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform [Channelling|Channelled], [Remote], Cooldown or [Conditional] Skills, or summon [Minion|Minions].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArc.name: Arc
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArc.description: An arc of [Lightning|Lightning] stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and [Chain|Chains] on to other nearby enemies. [Consume|Consumes] a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to deal more damage and [Chain] further.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArchonOfChay.name: Archon of Chayula
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArchonOfChay.description: Build [Glory] by dealing [Chaos] damage to enemies. When you have maximum [Glory], you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his [Archon].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcticArmour.name: Arctic Armour
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcticArmour.description: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals [Cold] [Spell] damage to the attacker.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourBreake.name: Armour Breaker
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourBreake.description: [Strike] with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their [Armour|Armour].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArtilleryBal.name: Siege Ballista
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArtilleryBal.description: Deploy a [Ballista] [Totem] that fires bolts skyward, to explode a short time after landing.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyAp.name: Apocalypse
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyAp.description: Build [Glory] by [Hit|Hitting] enemies with [ElementalDamage|Elemental] damage. When you have maximum [Glory], you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, [Trigger|Triggering] one of multiple powerful [ElementalDamage|Elemental] Skills at an interval while this [Buff] lasts.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.name: Supporting Fire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.description: Recruit artillery [Minion|Minions] that take up positions behind you. They will lie in wait for your [Command], then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyVi.name: Virtuous Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyVi.description: While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each [Attributes|Attribute] type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are [Hit].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeChop.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Chop
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeChop.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Bring your axe down in a sweeping slash, creating a slash along a line in the ground, with a chance to cause bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeExecute.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Execute
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeExecute.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Perform a heavy melee attack, dealing massive damage to enemies on low life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeHeavyClea.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Heavy Cleave
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeHeavyClea.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Ready your axe as it charges with flame, then swing in a massive flaming arc, sending out a slow wave of fire.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeLeapingCh.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Leaping Chop
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeLeapingCh.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Leap forward, dealing massive damage at the end of the attack.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeRaisedCho.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Raised Chop
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeRaisedCho.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Raise your weapon and channel rage into it, before slashing downwards and dealing massive damage to enemies the path of the attack.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeSlash.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Slash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeSlash.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Step forward and swing your axe, knocking enemies back to drag them with your attack.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeWhirlingS.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Whirling Slash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeWhirlingS.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Ready your axe then spin, dealing high damage to enemies and causing them to bleed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianSwar.name: Azmerian Swarms
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianSwar.description: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments] or hit [Rarity|Rare or Unique] enemies affected by [ElementalAilments|Elemental Ailments]. The swarms are untargetable [Minion|Minions] that pursue nearby enemies to [Attack] them and inflict [FaerieFire|Faerie Fire] on [Hit].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianWolf.name: Azmerian Wolf
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianWolf.description: Summons an ancient [Reviving] Azmerian Wolf that can howl, calling to spirits convening an Eternal Hunt on [Command]. It [Maim|Maims] when attacking foes, and can lunge to bite and inflict [Bleeding], or howl to inspire nearby allies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.name: Ball Lightning
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.description: Fire a slow-moving [Projectile] that moves through enemies. The [Projectile] itself does not [Hit] enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of [Lightning] at nearby enemies. Consumes a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to slow down over time, create [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground] as it travels, and explode dealing [Fire] damage in an Area after it dissipates.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrage.name: Barrage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrage.description: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, [Empowered|Empowering] your next [Repeat|Repeatable] [Bow|Bow] or [Projectile] [Spear|Spear] [Attack|Attack] to [Repeat] multiple times. Consumes your [Charges|Frenzy Charges] on use to add additional repeats.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrierInvoc.name: Barrier Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrierInvoc.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when your [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] is damaged by Enemy [Hit|Hits]. Using the Invocation once sufficient [Energy|Energy] is gathered will consume the [Energy|Energy] to trigger socketed [Spell|Spells], and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough [Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearMaul.name: Maul
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearMaul.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and rake enemies with your claws, generating [Rage] on [Hit].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.name: Rampage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and charge forward, [Slam|Slamming] the ground as you run. [Channelling] ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending [Rage].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBindSpectre.name: Bind Spectre
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBindSpectre.description: Capture the spirit of a defeated monster, transforming this gem to instead allow you to summon the monster's ghost as a [Reviving] [Minion|Minion].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBitterDead.name: Bitter Dead
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBitterDead.description: Spend [Ward] and target an area, transforming [Corpse|Corpses] into bitter cores that seek out enemies and [Chill] enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional [Cold] damage over time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBladeDance.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Blade Dance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBladeDance.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Perform a slashing attack that moves you through the battlefield, slicing all around you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBladeNova.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Blade Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBladeNova.description: Fire an arc of knives in front of the caster which deals physical damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlasphemy.name: Blasphemy
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlasphemy.description: Turn socketed [Curse] skills into vile [Aura|Auras], applying their effects to all nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodHunt.name: Blood Hunt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodHunt.description: Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered [BloodLoss|Blood Loss] will cause a blood explosion and also [Consume] [Bleeding]. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneOffering.name: Bone Offering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneOffering.description: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your [Minion|Minions] while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from [Hit|Hits]. Taking a [Hit] that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that [Minion|Minion's] shield to absorb all damage from that [Hit], then explode.  The bone spike is itself a [Minion], and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other [Minion|Minions] disappear.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneshatter.name: Boneshatter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneshatter.description: Attack enemies with a melee [Strike|Strike]. The [Strike|Strike] will cause a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] on enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun]. Upon causing a [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.name: Briarpatch
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.description: While active, a portion of the [Physical] [Attack] damage you deal is stored. Casting a [Spell] uses the stored damage to create a patch of [ThornyGround|Thorny Ground] that deals [Spell] damage to moving enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastCurseOnB.name: Curse on Block
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastCurseOnB.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Block|Block] and triggers socketed [Curse|Curses] on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnBlock.name: Cast on Block
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnBlock.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Block|Block] and triggers socketed [Spell|Spells] on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCharmU.name: Cast on Charm Use
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCharmU.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when one of your [Charm|Charms] is used and triggers socketed [Spell|Spells] on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCritic.name: Cast on Critical
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCritic.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Critical|Critically Hit] enemies and triggers socketed [Spell|Spells] on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnDodge.name: Cast on Dodge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnDodge.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.name: Cast on Elemental Ailment
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Freeze], [Shock], or [Ignite] enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnFreeze.name: Cast on Freeze
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnFreeze.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Freeze] enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnIgnite.name: Cast on Ignite
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnIgnite.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Ignite] enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeK.name: Cast on Melee Kill
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeK.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you kill enemies with [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeS.name: Cast on Melee Stun
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeS.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Stun] enemies with [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMinion.name: Cast on Minion Death
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMinion.description: While active, gains [Energy] when one of your [Persistent] [Minion|Minions] is [MinionDeath|Killed], and triggers socketed [Spell|Spells] upon reaching maximum [Energy]. Very underlevelled [Minion|Minions] will incur an [Energy] generation penalty. Cannot socket [Spell|Spells] which create [Minion|Minions].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnShock.name: Cast on Shock
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnShock.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Shock|Shock] enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhenDama.name: Cast when Damage Taken
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhenDama.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you take damage and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhenStun.name: Cast when Stunned
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhenStun.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you are [Stun|Stunned] and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhileCha.name: Cast while Channelling
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhileCha.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] while you're channelling a skill and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosbolt.name: Chaos Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosbolt.description: Fire a burst of [Chaos] energy at the target.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.name: Charged Staff
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.description: Consume all [Charges|Power Charges] to charge your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff] with electricity, adding [Lightning|Lightning] damage and a [Lightning|Lightning] shockwave to your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff] [Attack|Attacks]. Reusing this skill while the [Buff] is active adds to the [Buff]'s duration and damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemClawRake.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Claw Rake
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemClawRake.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Perform two upwards slashes, causing massive claw marks in the ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCoilingBolts.name: Coiling Bolts
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCoilingBolts.description: Simultaneously fires a [Physical] [Projectile] and a [Chaos] [Projectile] at the target. These projectiles [Chain] through any number of [Curse|Cursed] targets.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemComet.name: Comet
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemComet.description: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. [Consume|Consumes] a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductiveRu.name: Conductive Runes
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductiveRu.description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to create a number of [Hazard|Hazardous] Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal [Attack] damage that is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon]'s damage and apply [Electrocute|Electrocution] buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductivity.name: Conductivity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductivity.description: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their [Lightning] [Resistances|Resistance].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemContagion.name: Contagion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemContagion.description: Afflict a single enemy with a [Debuff] that deals [Chaos|Chaos] damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it spreads itself, [Curse|Curses], and other [Chaos|Chaos] damage over time [Debuff|Debuffs] on the target to nearby enemies. This refreshes their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the [Minion] or explosion to spread Contagion on hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpseCloud.name: Decompose
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpseCloud.description: Consume a [Corpse] to create a cloud of flammable [Poison|Poisonous] gas. Any [Burning|Burning] effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpsewadeCo.name: Decompose
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpsewadeCo.description: Consume a [Corpse] to create a cloud of flammable [Poison|Poisonous] gas. Any [Burning|Burning] effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingPal.name: Crackling Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingPal.description: When you [Hit] with [UnarmedAttack|Unarmed] [Melee] [Attack|Attacks], calls down lightning bolts which deal [UnarmedDamage|Unarmed] [Attack|Attack] damage to all surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingEart.name: [DNT] Crushing Earth
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingEart.description: [DNT] Convene the surrounding earth into an immense boulder to crash down, dealing high damage at the targeted location after a short delay.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingFear.name: Crushing Fear
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingFear.description: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, [CullingStrike|Culling] enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be [CullingStrike|Culled] will be highlighted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkPact.name: Dark Pact
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkPact.description: Sacrifice the life of a [Minion] to deal [Chaos] damage in an area around it. If you have no [Minion|Minions], your own life is sacrificed instead.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkTempest.name: His Dark Horizon
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkTempest.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Create a storm of deathly energies that [Empowered|Empowers] your Mana-costing [Spell|Spells] with [Cold] damage while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. As the storm persists it creates slowly expanding [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground]. Enemies that enter the eye of the storm are [Blinded]. When you leave the storm, or run out of Mana, the storm ends and unleashes a death-wave, damaging enemies on the [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDemonMagus.name: Demon Magus
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDemonMagus.description: Activate to summon a [Reviving] Demon Magus which casts socketed [Spell|Spells] in order.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDespair.name: Despair
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDespair.description: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their [Chaos|Chaos] [Resistances|Resistance].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateDead.name: Detonate Dead
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateDead.description: Cause a [Corpse] to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateLivi.name: Detonate Living
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateLivi.description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to cause a destabilising [Hit] against an enemy under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold], making them violently explode. Highlights enemies under the [CullingStrike|Culling Strike Threshold].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiscipline.name: Discipline
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiscipline.description: Emit an [Aura] that grants you and [Allies] in your [Presence] additional [Total] [EnergyShield|Energy Shield].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDisengage.name: Disengage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDisengage.description: Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. [Consume|Consumes] the [ParriedDebuff|Parried Debuff] on [Hit|Hitting] enemies to release a shockwave and grant you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge]. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes [Strike|Strikes] and [Projectile|Projectiles] to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be [AncestralBoost|Ancestrally Boosted].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthquake.name: Earthquake
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthquake.description: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] that slows enemies. The [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] erupts in a powerful [Aftershock] after a duration. Cannot create [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthshatter.name: Earthshatter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthshatter.description: [Slam|Slam] the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. [Warcry|Warcries] performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmberFusilla.name: Ember Fusillade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmberFusilla.description: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing [Fire] damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. [Consume|Consumes] a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that [Chain] to enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnervatingNo.name: Enervating Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnervatingNo.description: Unleash a [Nova] of [Lightning] damage to [Electrocute] enemies. Enemies close to you take no damage while enemies at the edge of the ring take significantly more damage. Enemies [Hit] can be [Electrocute|Electrocuted] by all [Lightning] damage for a short duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnfeeble.name: Enfeeble
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnfeeble.description: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEscapeShot.name: Escape Shot
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEscapeShot.description: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can [Chill] or [Freeze] enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create [IceFragment|Ice Fragments] on impact.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceDrain.name: Essence Drain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceDrain.description: Fire a [Projectile|Projectile] that applies a powerful [Chaos|Chaos] damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalMarch.name: Eternal March
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalMarch.description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to instantly [Reviving|Revive] your [Minion|Minions]. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEvasiveStrik.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Evasive Strike
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEvasiveStrik.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Leap back before dashing forward, taking out enemies in a path.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveTra.name: Explosive Transmutation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveTra.description: While active, picking up [Remnant|Remnants] [Trigger|Triggers] a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the [Remnant] based on the type of [Remnant] picked up.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExsanguinate.description: Expel your own blood as [Chain|Chaining] blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies [Hit] by the tendrils take [Physical] damage and are inflicted with [Bleeding].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEyeOfWinter.name: Eye of Winter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEyeOfWinter.description: Fire a single Eye [Projectile] which does not [Hit] enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard [Projectile|Projectiles] in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surface] or [Orb], it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding [DamageTypes|Type].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFallingThund.name: Falling Thunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFallingThund.description: Suffuse your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff] with electrical energy, then [Slam] the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your [Charges|Power Charges] to fire [Lightning|Lightning] [Projectile|Projectiles] forwards from the impact.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerociousRoa.name: Ferocious Roar
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerociousRoa.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and roar in defiance, immediately gaining [Rage] if there are enemies nearby and [Empowered|Empowering] subsequent [Attack|Attacks] to [ArmourBreak|Break Armour]. Alternatively, socketing a human-form [Warcry] into this Skill triggers that [Warcry] instead, and augments its damage and area. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirebolt.name: Firebolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirebolt.description: Launch a fiery [Projectile] towards a target. The [Projectile] explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirestorm.name: Firestorm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirestorm.description: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can [Consume] all three types of [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusion], creating a much larger storm when [ElementalInfusion|Fire-Infused], causing lightning bolts when [ElementalInfusion|Lightning-Infused], and raining ice bolts when [ElementalInfusion|Cold-Infused].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameWall.name: Flame Wall
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameWall.description: Create a wall of [Fire|Fire] in front of you, which [Ignite|Ignites] everything within its area. Any [Projectile|Projectiles] fired through the wall by you and [Allies] deal added [Fire|Fire] damage. [Consume|Consumes] a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to also add [Lightning] damage to the [Projectile|Projectiles].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameblast.name: Flameblast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameblast.description: [Channelling|Channel] to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you [Channelling|Channel] for.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlammability.name: Flammability
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlammability.description: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their [Fire] [Resistances|Resistance].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlickerStrik.name: Flicker Strike
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlickerStrik.description: Teleport to an enemy and [Strike] them. Consumes [Charges|Power Charges] to perform additional teleporting [Strike|Strikes] on nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFragmentsOfT.name: Fragments Of The Past
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFragmentsOfT.description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on initial eruption and [Trigger|Triggers] [IceFragment|Ice Fragments].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingShar.name: Freezing Shards
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingShar.description: Launch icy [Projectile|Projectiles] in a sweeping arc. Multiple [Projectile|Projectiles] can hit the same enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBomb.name: Frost Bomb
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBomb.description: Create a pulsing [Orb] of frost. Each pulse inflicts [ElementalDamage|Elemental] [Exposure|Exposure] on nearby enemies. When the [Orb]'s duration ends, it [DetonationTime|Detonates], dealing [Cold|Cold] damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostWall.name: Frost Wall
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostWall.description: Create a wall of [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] which holds back enemies. The [IceCrystals|Crystals] explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to add another [Lightning] explosion if destroyed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostbolt.name: Frostbolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostbolt.description: Fire a slow-moving [Pierce|Piercing] [Projectile|Projectile] that is effective at [Chill|Chilling] enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostflameNo.name: Frostflame Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostflameNo.description: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto [Ignite|Ignited] enemies, refreshing the duration of their active [Ignite] and rapidly [Freeze|Freezing] them but preventing them from being [Ignite|Ignited] further until the [Ignite] expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFungalTerrai.name: [DNT] Fungal Terrain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFungalTerrai.description: [DNT] Conjure a field of hazardous mushrooms that explode when enemies make contact. The explosion deals [Physical] damage and leaves a spore cloud that deals [Chaos] damage over time to enemies that enter the space.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuriousSlam.name: Furious Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuriousSlam.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Bear] and [Slam] the ground with great force, causing a pair of shockwaves. Can spend [Rage] to create larger shockwaves that leave behind [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuturePast.name: Future-Past
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuturePast.description: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.name: Galvanic Field
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.description: Gain a [Buff] that boosts your [Shock] chance. [Shock|Shocking] an enemy consumes the [Buff] to attach an [Orb] of electricity to that enemy. The [Orb] fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGelidPalm.name: Gelid Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGelidPalm.description: When you [Hit] with [Unarmed] [Melee] [Attack|Attacks], projects icy wind which deal [Unarmed] [Attack|Attack] damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGhostDance.name: Ghost Dance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGhostDance.description: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are [Hit] while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover [EnergyShield|Energy Shield] based on your [Evasion].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialCasca.name: Glacial Cascade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialCasca.description: Sweep your [Quarterstaff|Quarterstaff] upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. [Frozen|Frozen] enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the [Freeze] is [Consume|Consumed]. [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] hit by the final spike explode.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialClash.name: Soaring Midnight
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialClash.description: Hurl your [Shield] as a [Projectile] which [Return|Returns] to you at the end of its flight. While the [Shield] is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the [Shield] as it [Return|Returns], or destroy an [IceCrystals|Ice Crystal] with the Embrace the Fall.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialLance.name: Glacial Lance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialLance.description: Throw a single [Pierce|Piercing] lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments [Chill] nearby enemies. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first [Projectile] to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGraveCommand.name: His Grave Command
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGraveCommand.description: Conjure Abyssal spirits to [Hinder] a [Rarity|Rare] [MonsterCategory|Undead] for a duration. If you defeat the [MonsterCategory|Undead] while it is [Hinder|Hindered], it will be captured and stored into a Soul Crystal Skill Gem. The Soul Crystal will allow a wielder of great Abyssal power to summon the bound [MonsterCategory|Undead] as a [Reviving] [Companion].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGrimPillars.name: Grim Pillars
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGrimPillars.description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to cause damaging [IceCrystals|Ice-Crystal] spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of [Cold] damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHarbingerOfM.name: Harbinger of Madness
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHarbingerOfM.description: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and [Rarity|Rare] or [Rarity|Unique] enemies you [Hit], turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHazardousHol.name: Kinetic Bash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHazardousHol.description: [DNT] Raise your [Crossbow] to [Block] all incoming [Block|Blockable] hits. Releasing performs a Kinetic Bash, damaging enemies in front of you dealing more damage based on your [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun Buildup]. While your [Crossbow] is raised [Block|Blocking] too much damage may [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfAsh.name: Herald of Ash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfAsh.description: While active, enemies you sufficiently [Overkill] with non-[Herald] [Attack|Attacks] will cause an explosion that [Ignite|Ignites] nearby enemies based on the [Overkill] damage dealt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.name: Herald of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.description: While active, [Shatter|Shattering] an enemy with a non-[Herald] [Attack] [Hit] will cause an icy explosion that deals [Attack|Attack] damage to surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.name: Herald of Thunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.description: While active, killing [Shock|Shocked] enemies with a non-[Herald] [Attack] [Hit] will cause subsequent [Attack|Attack] [Hit|Hits] to release lightning bolts which deal[Attack|Attack] damage to all surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexblast.name: Hexblast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexblast.description: Detonate a [Curse] on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of [Chaos] damage but removing the [Curse]. Can only detonate [Curse|Curses] for which at least half of the duration has expired.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisFoulEmerg.name: His Foul Emergence
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisFoulEmerg.description: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving [WitheringGround|Withering Ground] in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisWinnowing.name: His Winnowing Flame
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisWinnowing.description: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing [Fire] damage to enemies and [Consume|Consuming] [Ignite] to create pillars of flame. Cannot be [Trigger|Triggered].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHollowShell.name: Hollow Shell
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHollowShell.description: Sacrifice your [Ward|Runic Ward] to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby [Allies] [Guard].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHyenaCackle.name: Cackling Companions
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHyenaCackle.description: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena [Companion|Companions]. The cackle is treated as a single [Companion] for effects that count or limit [Companion|Companions], regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, [Hinder|Hindering] nearby enemies, and have a chance to [Maim] enemies they [Hit].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHypothermia.name: Hypothermia
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHypothermia.description: [Curse] all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their [Cold] [Resistances|Resistance].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceNova.name: Ice Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceNova.description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, [Knockback|Knocking Back] enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt [Projectile] will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to leave a patch of [ChilledGround|Chilled Ground].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceStrike.name: Ice Strike
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceStrike.description: Perform a fast icy [Strike]. Using this [Attack|Attack] three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpurity.name: Impurity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpurity.description: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Chaos Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncinerate.name: Incinerate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncinerate.description: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of [Fire] from your hand, [Ignite|Igniting] enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you [Channelling|Channel]. [Consume|Consumes] a [Fire] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to also create [IgnitedGround|Ignited Ground]. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalCry.name: Infernal Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalCry.description: Perform a [Warcry], [Empowered|Empowering] subsequent [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKillingPalm.name: Killing Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKillingPalm.description: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, [CullingStrike|Culling] enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing [Strike|Strikes] to other [CullingStrike|Cullable] targets in range if your target was [CullingStrike|Culled]. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a [Charges|Power Charge], with higher [Rarity] monsters granting additional [Charges]. Enemies around you that can be [CullingStrike|Culled] will be highlighted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKnifeFlip.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Knife Flip
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKnifeFlip.description: Fire an arc of knives in front of the caster which deals physical damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeapSlam.description:
Jump into the air, damaging and [Knockback|Knocking Back] enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeylines.name: Leylines
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeylines.description: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful [Spell] damage boost but constantly drains your [Ward|Runic Ward]. Running out of [Ward|Runic Ward] causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningArr.name: Lightning Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningArr.description: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] beams at nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningBol.name: Lightning Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningBol.description: Call down a [Shock|Shocking] bolt of [Lightning] to strike enemies in a small area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningCon.name: Lightning Conduit
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningCon.description: Call down [Lightning] to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to [Shock|Shocked] enemies. If there is a [Shock|Shocked] enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.name: Lightning Spear
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.description: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt [Projectile|Projectiles] at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.name: Thundergod's Wrath
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.description: While active, gains [Energy|Energy] when you [Hit] enemies with [Melee] [Attack|Attacks] and triggers socketed [Lightning] spells on reaching maximum [Energy|Energy].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningWar.name: Lightning Warp
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningWar.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a [Debuff] to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning [Projectile|Projectiles]. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals [Lightning|Lightning] damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates [ShockedGround|Shocked Ground]. Creates a [Lightning] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be [CullingStrike|Culled].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLingeringIll.name: Lingering Illusion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLingeringIll.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a [Remnant] that grants you a [Charges|Power Charge] on pickup.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaTempest.name: Mana Tempest
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaTempest.description: Create a storm of arcane energies that [Empowered|Empowers] your Mana-costing [Spell|Spells] while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaBowTotem.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Meta Bow Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaBowTotem.description: Place a ballista totem which uses the socketed bow or wand attack skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMidnightStar.name: Midnight Zenith
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMidnightStar.description: While active, [Critical] [Hit|Hits] with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be [Consume|Consumed] to create [IceCrystals|Ice Crystals] near the most recent target.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirrorOfRefr.name: Mirror of Refraction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirrorOfRefr.description: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your [Presence] periodically. [Hit|Hitting] a mirror with a [Spell] [Projectile] causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied [Projectile|Projectiles] may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMistRaven.name: Mist Raven
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMistRaven.description: Summons a mysterious undamageable Mist Raven that can be [Command|Commanded] to dive at target location, crashing through an otherworldly mirror and damaging enemies in an area. The raven grants you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] for each enemy it [CullingStrike|Culls].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.name: Molten Crash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.description: [Shapeshift] into a burning monstrosity and leap through the air to crash down upon the earth, [Slam|Slamming] twice and creating [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures]. [Consume|Consumes] [Rage] to create additional [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenShower.name: Molten Shower
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenShower.description: Fires molten [Projectile|Projectiles] from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing [Attack] damage in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.name: Orb of Storms
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.description: Create an [Orb|Orb] of electricity that fires [Chain|Chaining] [Lightning] bolts at nearby enemies. The [Orb] leaves behind a [ElementalInfusion|Lightning Infusion] [Remnant] when it expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPainOffering.name: Pain Offering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPainOffering.description:
Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby [Minion|Minions] into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting. 
The bone spike is itself a [Minion]. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlagueBearer.name: Plague Bearer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlagueBearer.description: While active, stores a portion of the [Poison] Damage you deal. Using this Skill unleashes the stored [Poison|Poison] to damage and [Poison] enemies around you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPowerSiphon.name: Power Siphon
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPowerSiphon.description: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within [CullingStrike|Culling] range will be highlighted and instantly killed on [Hit], granting a [Charges|Power Charge]. Can only target Enemies in [CullingStrike|Culling] range.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoweredByVer.name: Powered by Verisium
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoweredByVer.description: Spends [Ward] to generate [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusions], which can be used in place of any [ElementalInfusion|Elemental Infusions].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfFire.name: Purity of Fire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfFire.description: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Fire Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfIce.name: Purity of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfIce.description: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Cold Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfLigh.name: Purity of Lightning
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfLigh.description: Emit an [Aura] that boosts the [Resistances|Lightning Resistance] of you and [Allies] in your [Presence].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfArrows.name: Rain of Arrows
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfArrows.description: Fire a hail of arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. [Consume|Consumes] a [Charges|Frenzy Charge] to fire more arrows.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfBlades.name: Rain of Blades
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfBlades.description: Pour your [Ward|Runic Ward] into conjuring blades. For the duration of the [Buff], these blades fall on enemies [Hit] by your [Projectile] [Attack|Attacks].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRaiseZombie.name: Raise Zombie
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRaiseZombie.description: Consume a [Corpse|Corpse] or [Charges|Power Charge] to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from [Charges|Power Charges] are [Empowered] and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAssault.name: Rapid Assault
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAssault.description: Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts [Bleeding] and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, [Maim|Maiming] them for a duration. [Detonator] Skills will cause the stuck spearheads to explode, dealing further damage to the target and other nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReap.name: Reap
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReap.description: Conjure a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing [Physical] damage to enemies and applying [CriticalWeakness|Critical Weakness]. Cannot be [Trigger|Triggered].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefutation.name: Refutation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefutation.description: Spends all your [Ward|Runic Ward] to gain a short-duration [Buff] that causes you to [Block] all [Block|Blockable] [Hit|Hits] and apply [ParriedDebuff|Parried] to enemies from which you've [Block|Blocked] a [Hit]. This [Buff] is removed if you are [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned]. While this [Buff] is active, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned], but [Block|Blocking] too much damage may [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantsOfKa.name: Remnants of Kalguur
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantsOfKa.description: While active, enemies you [Stun] or kill have a chance to generate a [Ward|Runic Ward] [Remnant]. These [Remnant|Remnants] can [Overflow] your [Ward|Runic Ward].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRend.name: Rend
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRend.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and perform a wide slash with your wingtip claws. Consumes a [Charges|Power Charge] if possible to grant you a [Buff] that gives you extra [Lightning] damage. While you have the [Buff], Rend covers a much larger area but is slower.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRepulsion.name: Repulsion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRepulsion.description: Spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to [Curse] enemies with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. [Hit|Hitting] these enemies removes the [Curse] to [Trigger] an explosion, [Knockback|Knocking Back] nearby enemies and causing more [Stun] buildup based on the Fragility on the target [Hit].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRhoaMount.name: Rhoa Mount
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRhoaMount.description: Harnesses a [Companion] Rhoa you can mount while you're wielding a [Bow] or [Spear]. While mounted you can use [Bow], thrown [Spear], and [Mark] Skills, and are much less slowed while using Skills, but being [Hit] will cause [HeavyStunPlayer|Heavy Stun] buildup. While you aren't mounted, the Rhoa will attack your enemies alongside you with its beak, but can be damaged.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRighteousDes.name: Righteous Descent
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRighteousDes.description: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a [DivineFragment|Fragment of Divinity] near you or the targeted location, this attack will [Consume] it when you leap to become [Empowered], dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRipwireBalli.name: Artillery Ballista
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRipwireBalli.description: Deploy a [Ballista] [Totem] that rains down a salvo of [Pinned|Pinning], [Maim|Maiming] bolts.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.name: Rolling Magma
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.description: [Shapeshift] into a [Wyvern] and lob a ball of magma that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill[Chain|Chains], bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. Impacts on [MoltenFissure|Molten Fissures] or Volcanos will activate them as though they were [Slam|Slammed].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingSlam.name: Rolling Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingSlam.description: [Slam|Slam] the ground to [Stun|Stun] enemies and [Knockback|knock them away], then continue forward and perform a devastating second [Slam|Slam].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicRepriev.name: Runic Reprieve
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicRepriev.description: [Channelling|Channel] to create a protective bubble all around you, [Block|Blocking] [Hit|Hits] against you. While [Channelling] this Skill, you cannot be [LightStun|Light Stunned] by [Hit|Hits] you [Block], and damage you take from [Hit|Hits] is also removed from [Ward|Runic Ward]. [Block|Blocking] [Hit|Hits] this way causes you to accumulate [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] buildup. You cannot recover [Ward|Runic Ward] while this Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicTemperi.name: Runic Tempering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicTemperi.description: [Channelling|Channel] to imbue your armour with Runic Plates. When you are [Hit] while you have these plates, some of the damage you would take will be prevented, and this skill will cause backlash, dealing your [Thorns] damage in an area around your attacker.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSavageFury.name: Savage Fury
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSavageFury.description: While active, your Fury builds from [Attack|Attacking] enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and [Onslaught] but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScatteringCa.name: His Scattering Calamity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScatteringCa.description: Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing [Lightning] damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeismicCry.name: Seismic Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeismicCry.description: Perform a damaging [Warcry], [Knockback|Knocking Back] nearby enemies and [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] enemies that are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun]. If an enemy is [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned] or a currently [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunned] enemy is [Hit], this Skill [Empowered|Empowers] subsequent [Slam|Slams] to perform an additional [Aftershock|Aftershock]. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an [Charges|Endurance Charge].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringPa.name: Shattering Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringPa.description: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them with an [Attack|Attack] that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals [Attack] damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringSp.name: Shattering Spite
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringSp.description: Stamp your spear, destroying all Bloodstone Lances on each enemy in your [Presence] to cause a damaging explosion around that enemy. Each explosion gains new benefits when reaching higher thresholds of Bloodstone Lances removed from an enemy, causing them to deal more damage, have increased area of effect, and [Leech] Life from enemies caught in the blast.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldCharge.name: Shield Charge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldCharge.description: [Channelling|Channel] to charge in the target direction. You will crash into enemies on your path, stopping your charge and dealing damage to enemies in an area, and extra damage to the enemies you collided with. While charging, your [Shield|Shield] is raised and you will [Block|Block] all incoming [Block|Blockable] hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.name: Shockwave Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.description: Raise a [Totem|Totem] that [Slam|Slams] the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground] erupts when hit by this [Slam|Slam], damaging enemies standing on it. The [Totem] cannot create [JaggedGround|Jagged Ground]. This Skill can be used while [Shapeshift|Shapeshifted].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShroud.name: Shroud
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShroud.description: Gain Stealth after not using Skills or being Hit for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfLife.name: Rite of Restoration
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfLife.description: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful [Buff] to you and [Allies] standing in it which grants Life Regeneration and amplifies [Armour], [Evasion] and [EnergyShield|Energy Shield]. The [Buff] becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfPower.name: Sigil of Power
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfPower.description: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful [Spell] Damage [Buff] to you and [Allies] while standing in it. The [Buff] becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalArso.name: Skeletal Arsonist
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalArso.description: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, [Reviving] Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other [Minion|Minions] on [Command].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalBrut.name: Skeletal Brute
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalBrut.description: Activate to summon hard-hitting, [Reviving] Skeletal Brutes that can [Stun] [PrimedStun|Primed] enemies and [Warcry] on [Command]. This [Warcry] [Intimidate|Intimidates] nearby enemies and [Consume|Consumes] [Freeze] on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalCler.name: Skeletal Cleric
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalCler.description: Activate to summon [Reviving] Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalFros.name: Skeletal Frost Mage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalFros.description: Activate to summon [Reviving] Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your [Minion|Minions] in an icy shield on [Command].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalReav.name: Skeletal Reaver
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalReav.description: Activate to summon aggressive, [Reviving] Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on [Command]. Skeletal Reavers do more [Attack] Damage and gain increased [Attack] speed based on their [Rage]

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalSnip.name: Skeletal Sniper
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalSnip.description: Activate to summon long-ranged, [Reviving] Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on [Command].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalStor.name: Skeletal Storm Mage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalStor.description: Activate to summon [Reviving] Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on [Command].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalWarr.name: Skeletal Sniper
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalWarr.description: Activate to summon long-ranged, [Reviving] Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on [Command].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkyfall.name: Skyfall
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkyfall.description: Build [Glory] by spending [Ward|Runic Ward]. When you have maximum [Glory], you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion]. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. [Consume|Consumes] a [VerisiumInfusion|Verisium Infusion], if possible, to increase the number of [TemporaryMinion|Minions] summoned.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSmashToSmith.name: Smash to Smithereens
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSmashToSmith.description: Blows strong enough to [HeavyStun|Heavy Stun] an enemy reverberate in an area around the enemy and heavily [ArmourBreak|Break Armour].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipersMark.name: Sniper's Mark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipersMark.description: [Mark] a target. The next [Critical|Critical Hit] the target receives [MarkActivate|Activates] the [Mark], [Consume|Consuming] it to deal extra damage and grant you a [Charges|Frenzy Charge].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulCrystal.name: Soul Crystal: {0}
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulCrystal.description: Summon a [Reviving] [MonsterCategory|Undead] [Companion] to aid you in combat.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulrend.name: Soulrend
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulrend.description: Fire a [Pierce|Piercing] [Projectile] that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a [Debuff] that [Hinder|Hinders] them and deals [Chaos] damage over time for a short duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpark.name: Spark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpark.description: Launch a spray of sparking [Projectile|Projectiles] that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. [Consume|Consumes] a [Cold] [ElementalInfusion|Infusion] if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearfield.name: Spearfield
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearfield.description: Stab the ground causing multiple spears to burst out of the ground in front of you in a large area. The spears remain for a duration, or explode when enemies touch them, damaging and [Maim|Maiming] them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellTotem.name: Spell Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellTotem.description: Consume any combination of 3 [Charges|Power and/or Endurance Charges] to raise a [Totem] that uses socketed [Spell|Spells]. Cannot use Skills with Cooldowns.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpinningFlai.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Spinning Flail
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpinningFlai.description: [DNT-UNUSED] Advance forward, striking enemies around you with whirling swings of your flail.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralVolley.name: Spiral Volley
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralVolley.description: Load your [Bow] with a volley of enchanted arrows and fire them in a circle as you spin forward, firing directly at targets if possible. Consumes [Charges|Frenzy Charges] to cause the arrows to deal more damage and [Chain] to other targets. Each target can only be [Hit] once.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralingCon.name: Spiraling Conspiracy
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralingCon.description: A flock of mist ravens circle you, dealing damage over time in an area. Their numbers are bolstered by slain foes, or in the [Presence] of dangerous enemies, but the flock as a whole is considered a single minion. You can [Command] some of them to take flight, leaving the flock to assail your enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiritVessel.name: Spirit Vessel
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiritVessel.description: Summons a [Shapeshift|Shapeshifting] Spirit Vessel [Companion] that uses copies of socketed [Bear], [Werewolf], and [Wyvern] Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.name: Staggering Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.description: Dash to an enemy and [Strike] them, instantly [HeavyStun|Heavily Stunning] enemies which are [PrimedStun|Primed for Stun] and performing additional dashing [Strike|Strikes] to other [PrimedStun|Primed] targets in range if your first target was [HeavyStun|Stunned]. [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] an enemy with this Skill grants you a [Buff] that causes your [Quarterstaff] [Attack|Attacks] to also fire [Projectile|Projectiles] for a short duration. [HeavyStun|Heavy Stunning] additional enemies adds to the [Buff]'s duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStarbornOnsl.name: Starborn Onslaught
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStarbornOnsl.description: Build up Glory by [Freeze|Freezing] or [Chill|Chilling] enemies. When you have maximum [Glory] you may jump backwards loosing your [Mace] with the force of a falling comet onto your target. The impact releases [MoltenFissure|Fissures] and causes stars to fall in the area for a brief period.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonBeast.name: Companion: {0}
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonBeast.description: Summon a [Reviving] [MonsterCategory|Beast] [Companion] to aid you in combat.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonMercen.name: Summon Companion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonMercen.description: Summon a [Reviving] Companion to aid you in combat. The Mercenary will use socketed [Attack|Attacks], and can be given equipment in the Skills Panel.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonSpectr.name: Spectre: {0}
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonSpectr.description: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a [Reviving] [Minion].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSunder.name: Sunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSunder.description: [Slam] the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with [ArmourBreak|Fully Broken Armour] applies [SunderedArmour|Sundered Armour], making it take additional increased [Physical] damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupercharged.name: Supercharged Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupercharged.description: [Channelling|Channel] to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to [Slam|Slam] the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by [Aftershock|Aftershocks] dealing damage in a larger area. This Skill has its own [Attack] time, which is not affected by your weapon's attack speed and cannot be modified.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestFlurr.name: Tempest Flurry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestFlurr.description: Perform a series of aggressive [Strike|Strikes]. When used in quick succession, the third use [Strike|Strikes] three times, and the fourth use performs a [FinalStrike|Final Strike] that calls down a powerful [Shock|Shocking] bolt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalChai.name: Temporal Chains
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalChai.description: [Curse] all enemies in an area, [Slow|Slowing] them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTheStarsAnsw.name: The Stars Answer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTheStarsAnsw.description: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly [Trigger|Triggering] Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderstorm.description: Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become [Shock|Shocked] or [Frozen] more easily. [Plant|Plants] in the area become [Plant|Overgrown].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornado.name: Tornado
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornado.description: Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals [Physical] damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an [ElementalGround|Elemental Ground Surface] absorbs that surface's [Debuff], applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.name: Trail of Caltrops
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.description: While active, scatters caltrops in your wake when you dodge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTriskelionCa.name: Triskelion Cascade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTriskelionCa.description: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to [Empowered|Empower] the next [Cascadable|Cascadable] [Spell] you cast. The [Empowered] [Spell] becomes centred on your location, and [Cascadable|Cascades] to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueAtziri.name: Herald of the Royal Queen
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueAtziri.description: Killing an enemy with [BloodLoss|Blood Loss] will cause a bloody explosion that deals [Physical] [Attack] damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your [MartialWeapon|Weapon Damage], but is based on their accumulated [BloodLoss|Blood Loss]. The explosion destroys their [Corpse] if the enemy was [Rarity|Normal or Magic].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemValakosCharg.name: Valako's Charge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemValakosCharg.description: While active, taking [Lightning] damage builds up charge on you. Reaching full charge expends all charge to [Trigger] this skill, creating a [Chain|Chaining] lightning bolt that arcs to nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVerisiumMani.name: Verisium Manifestations
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVerisiumMani.description: While active, [Hit|Hitting] with an [Attack] will spend [Ward|Runic Ward] to summon a Verisium Manifestation, a short-lived [TemporaryMinion|Temporary Minion] that rapidly [Attack|Attacks] nearby enemies, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these [Minion|Minions], and can pass through them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVileDisrupti.name: His Vile Intrusion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVileDisrupti.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a [Debuff] to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the [CullingStrike|Cull] threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals [Physical|Physical] damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts [Impale|Impale].

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatileDead.name: Volatile Dead
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatileDead.description: Consume a [Corpse] to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and [Ignite|Ignites] enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicFiss.name: Volcanic Fissure

Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemWither.name: Withering Presence
Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemWither.description: While active, emits an [Aura] that periodically [Withered|Withers] enemies in your [Presence].

Metadata/items/Gems/SkillGemStaffConsecr.name: Consecrate
Metadata/items/Gems/SkillGemStaffConsecr.description: Create an area of [ConsecratedGround|Consecrated Ground] around you.

Metadata/items/Gems/SkillGemStaffUnleash.name: Unleash
Metadata/items/Gems/SkillGemStaffUnleash.description: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, [Empowered|Empowering] the next [Repeat|Repeatable] [Spell] you cast to [Repeat|Repeat] multiple times. Cannot [Empowered|Empower] Skills with a Cooldown.
